description: Outreach funnel for the last 90 days by how each prospect was found (intersection = competitor linkers, footprint = resource pages, mention = topical mentions, fresh = fresh competitor links, brand_mention = brand mentions, ai_source = AI sources, legacy = earlier rows): prospects, sent, replied and placed with reply and placement rates per send, plus the total, and aiSources: the AI sources found this billing window (found), the 100 a window allows (cap) and when the window resets (resetsAt). The harvest reads the same numbers to weight its methods; nothing to configure.
name: get_outreach_stats
